Name: Cropgenics
Author: Owenynk112
Description:
[size=4][b]1.Description[/b][/size]

[size=4]Cropgenics turns ordinary farming into a living genetics lab — without taking the cozy out of it. Watch for crops that come out different, snip a sample, breed the trait into a stable line, and slowly [b][size=4][color=#ea9999]build a farm that's entirely your own[/color].[/size][/b] Along the way you'll [color=#a4c2f4]meet a forest botanist and [/color][color=#8e7cc3]a wandering flower-seeker, [/color]and put your prize plants on show for the whole town.[/size]

[size=4]Currently, content is available in both [b][color=#f4cccc]simplified Chinese and English[/color][/b].[/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782232182-795938521.png[/img]
[line]
[color=#ff0000][size=4][font=Arial Black][b]Download may become available after Nexus virus scanning finishes. [/b][/font][/size][/color]

[b][color=#ffff00][size=4]Main features[/size][/color][/b]

[b][color=#00ff00][size=4]1. The breeding loop[/size][/color][/b]
Any crop may quietly reveal a natural mutation the day it matures — a chance encounter, not a checklist. Sample it with the Pruning Shears (the crop is consumed — a record made at a cost). Breed & stabilize at the Breeding Station so traits carry into new seed varieties that breed true across generations. Craft or extract Trait Inducers to grant a chosen trait to any crop — within a species or across species.
Traits that change how you farm (a taste of the ~40 on offer):

[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=4]Useful traits[/size][/color][size=4]:[/size] Faster growth or regrowth,  higher yields, higher quality...[/b]
[b][size=4][color=#c27ba0]Cosmetic traits[/color] [/size]:  Soft night glow, attracting butterflies and fireflies ,  petal rain, bubbles...[/b]
[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782224926-125509750.gif[/img][/b]
[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782224931-1894796464.gif[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782224925-760375193.gif[/img][/b]
[line]

[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]2. Ten rare species[/b][/size][/color]
Beyond ordinary traits lie ten legendary flowers. Each is cultivated only by satisfying a quiet ecological condition: the right neighbors, the right weather, undisturbed nights... The almanac records the conditions; the valley keeps the rest.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782225434-1329454433.png[/img]
Wait a moment. Wasn't it said to be ten? Well... There is another type which is the protagonist of the story, and it is up to you to discover it.
[line]

[color=#f9cb9c][size=4][b]3. Chronicle it & show it off[/b] [/size][/color]
A handwritten Breeding Almanac records every trait and rare species you discover; a Polaroid camera lets you photograph your prize crops; and once Robin raises a small Exhibition Tent beside the Community Center, you can invite villagers to come pose beside your flowers for the album.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782225058-125605083.jpg[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782225060-780441359.jpg[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782225069-1209366421.jpg[/img]
[line]

[b][color=#3c78d8][size=4]4. The Two Newcomers[/size][/color][/b]

[b][size=4][color=#6d9eeb]1) Fernando[/color] [/size][color=#6d9eeb][size=3](Romanceable)[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#6aa84f]A botanist[/color] who fled the paperwork of Zuzu City University for a half-collapsing cabin south of Cindersap Forest, where he studies the valley's impossibly active plant life. Precise, dry, and quietly self-deprecating; he runs on coffee and stubbornness, and turns out kinder than his spreadsheets suggest. [color=#6aa84f]He is your guide to breeding. [/color]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782227961-394584649.png[/img]
[color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b]2) Oriko[/b][/size] [/color]
[color=#8e7cc3]A traveler [/color]who has walked far stranger roads than most: gentle and poetic, with a sword's edge underneath. She came to Pelican Town chasing [color=#6d9eeb]a childhood memory — a single blue rose[/color] that glowed in the dark and led her safely down a mountain — and is [color=#ffd966]searching for more legendary flowers[/color]. She plays the pipa( a Chinese lute ) on the hillside and photographs the things others overlook.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782224570-53032882.png[/img]
Both have their own heart events, daily and seasonal schedules and festival moments.
[line]
[color=#ffff00][size=5]How to breed?[/size][/color]
1.Use your [b][color=#93c47d]Pruning Shears[/color] to collect [color=#6aa84f]sample from maturation plant（as parent sample) or mutated plants(as source sample).[/color][/b]
[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782230847-1278866055.png[/img][/b]
[b]2.[color=#93c47d]Check the mutant samples[/color] through  [color=#ff7700]Breeding Station.[/color][/b]
[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782230828-568730275.png[/img][/b]
3.By using [color=#93c47d]mutant samples and the parent samples[/color], new crops were cultivated. You will receive [color=#38761d][b]3~5 new generation seeds. [/b][/color](They got traits from mutant samples and can be used as new parent samples! And you can name them by yourself, cool!)
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48079/48079-1782230833-1329815751.png[/img]
[b]Some traits have levels, use the same mutant samples and the parental individuals carrying the corresponding traits can enhance the trait level.[/b]

[color=#e69138][size=4][b]Carry out cultivation to advance the story![/b][/size][/color]
[line]

[spoiler][b][color=#a2c4c9][size=4]Main storyline (including trigger conditions and plot revelations)[/size][/color][/b]
[b]1. Meet Fernando — Bus Stop[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Trigger:[/b] on a [b]Sunday[/b] (the 7th / 14th / 21st / 28th of any month), be at the [b]Bus Stop[/b], 06:00–17:00. Miss it and you can catch the next Sunday.[/*]
[/list][b]2. Forest lab intro — get the Pruning Shears[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Trigger:[/b] on a [b]later day[/b] (not the same day as the bus meeting), visit [b]Cindersap Forest[/b], 06:00–17:00.[/*]
[*]You receive the [b]Pruning Shears[/b]: use them on a mature crop showing a natural trait to collect a [b]Crop Sample[/b] (the crop is consumed).[/*]
[/list][b]3. Festival Trait — Farm[/b] [i](the gate for Oriko's storyline!)[/i]
[list]
[*][b]Trigger:[/b] [b]Farm[/b], [b]sunny[/b], 06:00–11:30, festival traits unlocked, and you've [b]planted or harvested a crop carrying a festival hidden trait[/b].[/*]
[*]Attending a festival can "imprint" a hidden trait (Moonlit / North Star / Foxfire / Fragrant / Garland) onto a crop. Plant or harvest it, and the scene fires on your Farm the next sunny morning.[/*]
[/list][b]4. Meet Oriko — Adventure Guild[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Trigger:[/b] after step 4, [b]Oriko's introduction letter[/b] arrives; [b]read it[/b], then go to the [b]Adventure Guild[/b] (Marlon's).[/*]
[*]Oriko appears and tells the legend of the [b]Blue Moon Fairy[/b]; the almanac's Rare Species page opens.[/*]
[/list][b]5. Breed the Blue Moon Fairy → lab event[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Recipe:[/b] on a [b]Fairy Rose[/b], stabilize [b]Azure + Moonlit + Starveined Lv.3[/b] to breed the [b]Blue Moon Fairy[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Lab event:[/b] archive it at Fernando's lab, then enter the lab at [b]night (20:00–02:00)[/b] to trigger the scene.[/*]
[/list][b]6. The Exhibition Tent[/b]
[list]
[*]After the Blue Moon Fairy, the reward chain begins → Oriko mails a [b]proposal letter[/b] → read it, meet Robin at the [b]Carpenter's Shop[/b] → drop the materials into Robin's materials box → Robin raises the tent beside the [b]Community Center[/b] that evening.[/*]
[*]Then use [b]Day / Night Visit Tickets[/b] to invite villagers to pose with your crops for the album (needs the [b]Polaroid camera[/b] — see Key Items).
Key items[/*]
[*][color=#00ff00][b]Pruning Shears[/b] [i](forest intro)[/i] [/color]— sample mature, trait-bearing crops.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][color=#00ff00][b]Breeding Station[/b] [i](recipe unlocked after getting your first samples)[/i] [/color]— breed/stabilize varieties, inspect seed traits, extract inducers.[/*]
[*][b][color=#c27ba0]Polaroid Camera[/color][/b] — given by [b]Oriko on a mountaintop encounter[/b] once you've [b][color=#d5a6bd]befriended her[/color][/b]; photographs crops & group shots into the almanac and exhibition. Grab it early — it's required for the tent.[/*]
[*][b][color=#b4a7d6]Rare species [/color][/b] — given by [b]Oriko on 1th/15th of every season after you have bred out the blue moon fairy.[/b]
There are two rare species for each season. They cannot be grown in greenhouses and are very particular about their environment. If you unfortunately lose all the rare species, Fernando will send some replacements, but there will be a time gap between each delivery.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[line]

[b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/color][/b]
1. Install SMAPI. 
2. Unzip Cropgenics into Stardew Valley/Mods. 
3. Launch via SMAPI.
[line]

[color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/b][/*]
[*][i](Optional)[/i] [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[b][size=4][color=#ff0000]Compatibility[/color][/size][/b]
[size=3]✅ [color=#ff7700]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color] — preliminary compatibility (events & schedules account for SVE's reworked maps).
⚠️ Early release: [/size]
[size=3]Cropgenics adds Fernando's lab in [color=#ff0000]Cindersap Forest[/color], the Exhibition Tent beside the [color=#ff0000]Community Center,[/color] and routes NPCs through schedule points around[color=#ff0000] town, forest, and mountains[/color]. [/size]
[size=3]Other mods that [color=#cc0000]heavily edit those areas may overlap and need future compatibility work[/color] — please report conflicts and wider compat is on the roadmap.[/size]

[color=#ffff00][b][size=3]⚠️[/size][/b][b][size=4] Initial Release — Bug Reports & Ideas Welcome[/size][/b][/color]
[size=4]First public version, [color=#cc0000][b]so bugs are likely. Please help[/b][/color]:[/size]
[size=3]Found a [/size][color=#ff0000][size=4]bug?[/size][/color][size=3][size=3] [/size][/size][size=3] Post it with repro steps, and attach your SMAPI log (upload at https://smapi.io/log and paste the link) — it makes fixes & compatibility work far faster.[/size]

[size=3]Got an[/size][size=4] [color=#fff2cc][size=4]idea?[/size][/color]  [/size][size=3]Leave it in the posts — I'm reading suggestions and will seriously consider implementing fun traits, flowers, events, or features.[/size]

[b]Due to limited time, [/b]the current [color=#0b5394][b][size=4]English version has[/size] [size=4]not been meticulously polished yet[/size]. [/b][/color]
[b][color=#cc0000]If you notice any wrong terms, or sentences that don't make sense, please let me know![/color][/b]
Also, if any community members are interested in optimizing the translation, please feel free to contact me.

[b][color=#00ff00][size=4]Still growing 🌱 (planned)[/size][/color][/b]
Cropgenics is in early development and will keep growing. On the list:
- More traits — useful ones and purely-for-fun cosmetic ones alike.
- More story: extra events and dialogue for Fernando and Oriko, plus polish on what's already there.
- Ongoing cleanup of the English text.
[line]

[b]⚠️[/b] [b][size=4]AI usage statement:[/size][/b]
[color=#ff0000][b]The illustrations and UI art materials within the game are AI-generated; UI art materials within the game.[/b][/color]
[line]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Special thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community, the SMAPI team, wiki contributors, and everyone who helps make modding possible.
Thank you to everyone who tries Cropgenics during early development , reports bugs, shares feedback, or simply enjoys growing strange little plants!

Manifest.Name: Cropgenics
Manifest.Description: Cropgenics is a crop-breeding overhaul for Stardew Valley 1.6. Collect natural traits from your harvests, breed and stabilize new varieties, and cultivate nine rare flowers through ecological rituals - all chronicled in the Breeding Almanac. Adds two characters, Fernando and Oriko, with their own story, schedules and events, plus an exhibition tent where villagers pose with your prize crops for album photos. Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded.
